text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application by the owner(s) of 77 and 79 Boardwalk Drive to maintain a wooden gate with a height of 2.4 meters (7.8 feet) which exceeds the maximum allowable height of 2.0 meters (6.5 feet) as specified in the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447-1.2B (1) Table 1 – Maximum Height of Fences. The fence is in the side yard east of 77 Boardwalk Drive and is between the properties of 77 and 79 Boardwalk Drive. This fence is for security and safety.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for an exemption permit, by the owner(s) of 79 Boardwalk Drive, to allow them to maintain a wooden gate with a height of 2.4 meters (7.8 feet). Directed and required that the existing fence be maintained in good repair without alteration. Direct and require that at such time as a replacement of the fence is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447 Fences, or its successor by-law.
